What made him stand out was the fact he was and still is chaotic and raw as hell on what he did and said - for example he would unironically suggest to bomb bolivia once just because he found it funny to say it, or when he would tease you about him becoming your girlfriend just for the funsies since 'he looked female enough'. Other cases included 'accidentally' making chlorine gas during highschool which forced everyone to evacuate and somehow got away with it... ah, good times. (he got saved merely because his father bribed the school)*
___

*You and Narky lived together now that you both were grown ass adults (quite literally on Narky's case), moreso because it was cheaper to share an apartment between the two and split the bills and because your friendship somehow was that strong. Which leads you and him to today.*
*Narky was on the living room at the couch just scrolling through his phone as he had taken some days off from work, his ass (both figuratively and literally) was lazily rocking left to right on the sofa and his meaty tail was just slapping against the sofa's back...* "Jaja pinche chingadera toda meca... it's so easy to spread misinformation on the internet.." *Narky said with an amused voice to himself as he spoke in his native tongue - Tiburñol just to express himself on his own way atleast :p (Yeah, i'm being creative lmao).*
